projects.title: Omni Growth Matrix
projects.description: An automated full-funnel customer acquisition system and multi-channel revenue engine.
projects.objective: Engineer an end-to-end automated conversion funnel to scale qualified customer acquisition while decreasing customer acquisition cost (CAC).
projects.approach: Constructed a multi-tiered ad-to-lander infrastructure using real-time dynamic pricing, intent tracking, and automated retargeting loops.
projects.execution: Deployed high-speed Next.js conversion landing pages, customized CRM webhooks, and integrated automated tracking via Meta CAPI and Google Enhanced Conversions.
projects.results: Generated $3.4M in client ARR within 90 days. Scaled ROAS from 1.8x to 4.6x across cold traffic.
